description: B holds 20 rows of three fields. For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over B and each GetRows argument [(no argument) ;; Missing ;; Long 0 ;; Long 1 ;; Long 3 ;; Long -1 ;; Long 20 ;; Long 21 ;; Long 1000000 ;; Null ;; Empty ;; "3" ;; "abc" ;; Double 2.5 ;; Integer 3 ;; Boolean True]: fresh recordset at its first row, call GetRows, read BOF, EOF and ID. The call's VARIANT is captured exactly. Asks the array VARIANT shape (dimensions, bounds, element types) per requested count, the accepted argument types, the count beyond the row total and the position after the call. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
